learning_outcomes.text: Student knows and understands the meaning of basic electrothermics concepts discussed in the "Electrical Heating" course.
Student knows and understands the operation of basic electric heating methods, the structure and properties of selected electrothermal devices, and their areas of application.
Student has up-to-date knowledge about the use of available electrothermal technologies in various industrial implementations.
Student can design a resistive heating element for a resistance furnace.

Student can estimate the electrical parameters of the inductor-charge system and the penetration depth of the electromagnetic field into the charge, which translates into the distribution of this field in the charge.
Student can determine the efficiency of an electrothermal device and estimate the distribution of the generated temperature field.
Student is able to cooperate with a group while taking measurements and formulating conclusions about the properties of the tested device.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to electrical heating. Basic concepts and classification systems of electrothermics: Area of interest of electrothermics. Charge, heating element, electrothermal transducer. Heating methods. Autonomous and associated electrothermal transformations. Direct and indirect heating. Chamber and chamberless devices. Industrial vs. domestic electrothermics.
Resistive heating – design of a heating element for a resistance furnace

Thermal processes in electrothermal systems: Energy transformations. Heat transfer methods. Electrical, thermal, and electrothermal efficiency. Thermal insulation, refractory, and electrical insulation materials.
Temperature measurement and control: Temperature scales and classification of thermometers. Thermoelectric and resistance thermometers.
Resistive heating. Control (phase, group) and regulation of output power of resistive electrothermal devices. Analysis of systems, oscillographic recording of waveforms.
Electrode heating - testing a furnace model (testing electrothermal efficiency and determining the optimal operating point of the heating system).

Resistive and radiant heating: Direct chamberless and chamber resistive devices. Resistive heating materials. Indirect chamberless and chamber resistive devices. Room heating: basic conditions for thermal comfort, accumulation devices, underfloor heating. Radiant devices and their applications.
Electrode heating: Principles of electrode heating. Water heating devices. Glass melting devices. Metal remelting devices. Non-ferrous metal production devices.
Arc heating: Principles of arc heating. Arc furnaces. Current operating characteristics. Automatic electrode movement systems for arc furnaces.

Induction heating: Principles of induction heating. Propagation of electromagnetic waves in a conductive medium, penetration depth of the electromagnetic field into the charge. Distribution of current density and power in the charge. Induction heaters. Crucible and channel furnaces. Power sources for induction heating devices. Frequency converters in induction heating. Induction cookers.
Simulation studies of basic resonant circuit topologies and selected inverters for induction heating.
Capacitive and microwave heating: Principles of capacitive and microwave heating. Heating of dielectrics in a high-frequency alternating electric field. Microwave ovens.
Microwave oven - study of output power control, electrothermal efficiency, temperature field distribution and absorption coefficient of different materials.

Other electric heating methods and devices using them: Principles of heating. Generation of low-temperature plasma stream. Plasmatrons. Electron beam devices and their thermal applications. Laser devices and their thermal applications. Glow discharge and ultrasonic heating.

Testing of various types of electric cookers: - infrared glass-ceramic cooker (infrared type) - study of output power control and electrothermal efficiency, - induction cooker - study of output power control and electrothermal efficiency, - various types of resistance cookers - study of output power control and electrothermal efficiency.
Principles of safe operation of electrothermal devices: Normative requirements for safe operation of electrothermal devices.
Air conditioning module built from Peltier modules - analysis of operation and structural requirements, study of cooling power, time constant and electrothermal efficiency of the manufactured model.
assessment_rules: Lectures are verified by a test. Laboratory classes are verified by activity during classes, a test, a project, and a report. Students must be prepared for lab exercises, which may be verified by an oral or written colloquium. Passing the lab module requires passing all laboratory classes.
